newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand plans 9.0 percent rise in 97/98 budget.
newsitem.headline: Thailand plans 9.0 percent rise in 97/98 budget.

text.p: Thailand's cabinet on Tuesday planned a government budget of 1.008 trillion baht ($38.77 billion) billion baht for the fiscal year 1997/1998 ending September compared with 925 billion baht for fiscal 1996/97.
A government spokesman told reporters that the government would continue to adopt a balanced budget policy in the next fiscal year.
The government budget in 1997/98 fiscal year would represent 17.4 percent of Thailand's gross domestic product (GDP), he said.
Of the total budget, 411.5 billion baht or 40.8 percent of the budget would comprise investment by the government, while the remainder would be for fixed spending, the spokesman said.
